sources.title: Macao DSI: Guinea-Bissau travel-convenience record
sources.publisher: Identification Services Bureau, Macao SAR Government
sources.officialityEvidence: The live DSI passport-specific record sets travelPermit to 0, visaFree to 0 and visaOnArrival to 1; its English remark identifies Osvaldo Vieira International Airport.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visitors can obtain visa upon arrival at Osvaldo International Airport.

policies.title: Macao SAR passports: Guinea-Bissau arrival visa
policies.summary: The current Macao DSI passport-specific record classifies Guinea-Bissau as visa on arrival, rather than visa-free access, for the Macao SAR Passport.
conditions: This applies only to the Macao SAR Passport, not to a PRC passport, Hong Kong document, Portuguese passport, residence document or other travel document.
The DSI record identifies Osvaldo Vieira International Airport as the arrival-visa location and states a maximum period of 90 days.
Purpose, passport validity, fees, carrier requirements and final admission remain subject to the Guinea-Bissau authorities.
